svg.title: Drizzlet hidden options guide
svg.desc: Four pages of mix knob settings with quality LED [A] colour and blink indications. Full text version in OPTIONS.md.

g.text: 3. [A] previews stored values. Turn a mix
knob, not a big knob, to edit.
4. Close: hold [M] 3 seconds or press another
button. Page 1 Scale: tap SEED to step.
Wait after edits before power-off. Move a knob
Random pitch steps: relative to pitch; scale follows.
Manual gain: Hold [A], turn FEEDBACK. With
an input patched, a long [A] press returns
the next freeze keeps only what follows.
fully CCW is none. [M] can route CV to it.
Synth start Manual, no inputs, FREEZE off:
Don't hold SEED while powering on:
it resets all settings to defaults
Author: Insolent Construct • Control sketch • Panel layout from the Mutable Instruments Beads panel file, geometry only (CC BY-SA 3.0).
